<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# First retract the path
print("Retracting path...")
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    if not last_action_result.get('board_changed', False):
        print(f"  LEFT {i+1}: no more change")
        break

# Get current player position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
player = next((n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18), None)
if player:
    rows = [p[0] for p in player['boundary']]
    print(f"  Player: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}")

# Move UP to align with green block (rows 31-34)
# Player is at rows 36-41, need to move UP 1 to get to rows 30-35
print("\nMoving UP to align with green...")
result = action(['UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
player = next((n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18), None)
if player:
    rows = [p[0] for p in player['boundary']]
    print(f"  Player: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}")

# Extend RIGHT
print("\nExtending RIGHT...")
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    if not last_action_result.get('board_changed', False):
        print(f"  RIGHT {i+1}: no more change")
        break

# Check if green block is now attached
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
print("\n=== Blocks ===")
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] in 'RbN':
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        print(f"  {n['color']}: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}, children={n['children']}")

# Check adjacency to see if path connects to green
print("\n=== Path adjacency ===")
for adj in seg['adjacency_list']:
    i, j = adj
    ci = next((n['color'] for n in nodes if n['id'] == i), '?')
    cj = next((n['color'] for n in nodes if n['id'] == j), '?')
    if ci == 'N' or cj == 'N':
        print(f"  {i}({ci}) -- {j}({cj})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
